title: Report automation left out, and a manual check in the DAW of the automate example
description:
## Intent

Report automation the set can't hold, and prove M4 in the DAW.

## Steps

- Warnings for lanes whose target was left out of its device (M3's list), located by the automate line.
- Manual (owner with the DAW): put the `automate` example from `docs/language.md` (the `stab` track) in a score, export it, open it: envelopes visible on the right controls, the fade, the step and the sweep audible; A/B against `apricity render`.

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test daw` — "Automation that can't be kept is reported" passes; a comment with the DAW check.

## Release

`feat(<this task's id>): report automation a DAW set can't hold`. Not breaking.
